recognize_zh: CD5 染色下大片中型腫瘤細胞呈膜/質陽性（強度中等），少數細胞顏色更深（背景 T 細胞），內皮與間質細胞為陰性；B 細胞淋巴瘤出現異常 CD5 表現，縮小到被套細胞淋巴瘤與 CLL/SLL 的鑑別。
features: Diffuse membranous/cytoplasmic CD5 staining of intermediate-sized tumor cells
Moderate staining intensity in tumor cells, with scattered more intensely stained small T cells
Negative stromal/endothelial cells along small vessels
Monotonous sheet-like growth with round nuclei
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD5 shows moderate membranous and cytoplasmic staining in the diffuse sheets of neoplastic lymphoid cells, with a few more strongly staining small reactive T cells and negative vascular and stromal elements. Aberrant CD5 expression in a B-cell lymphoma narrows the differential chiefly to mantle cell lymphoma and CLL/SLL. With cyclin D1 positivity and LEF1 negativity, findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: CLL/SLL is also CD5+ but is CD23+, LEF1+, and cyclin D1-, with proliferation centers.
PTCL is CD5+ (or shows CD5 loss) but tumor cells are CD3+ and lack B-cell markers.
CD5+ DLBCL consists of large cells with vesicular chromatin and is cyclin D1- and SOX11-.
